source: Constructed to exercise dictionary entry 'I don't know' (4->1 tokens). Coverage-favorable by construction; not a workload sample.

messages.content: Sam stated plainly: I don't know where the brass key is. Does Sam know where the brass key is? Answer only YES or NO.

source: Exercises 'I don't want' (4->1). Negation must survive substitution.

messages.content: Tomas told the clerk: I don't want the blue folder. Does Tomas want the blue folder? Answer only YES or NO.
The safety inspection was carried out by Nadia. The audit was carried out by Peder. Who carried out the safety inspection? Return only the name.
Ravi said to him that the north gate was locked. Elin said to him that the south gate was open. Who said the north gate was locked? Return only the name.
Leo lifted up the crate. Mara lifted up the ladder. Nobody else lifted up anything. Who lifted up the crate? Return only the name.
Ines and the dispatcher don't know what time the freight train departs, and you don't know either. Does Ines know the departure time? Answer only YES or NO.
